title: driftkings
author: driftkings
changelog: BETA NOTICE: the settings panel is still under construction; layouts and live previews may contain errors.
Performance: this beta lowers the modpack's cost in battle, measured with CapFrameX and the in-game diagnostics on EU replays. Settings and profiles are unchanged.

Player statistics: vehicle statistics are fetched in parallel and each account appears as soon as it answers. Delivered accounts are applied a few at a time, so a batch no longer freezes one frame for up to 200 ms (now about 11 ms at most).

Team panels: the side panel and TAB redraw when battle events change them instead of four times a second, and only changed rows are sent to Flash. The loading-screen clock now keeps time inside Flash.

Team panels: in standard battles the side panel attaches to the game's own rows (driftkingspanels.swf, loaded only for the classic battle page). It redraws only when data or a row changes and matches rows by vehicle; in a random battle each pass fell from about 5.4 ms to 0.6-1.4 ms. Ranked, Frontline and other modes keep the previous method.
Team panels: if another mod already replaces the same panel classes, Driftkings falls back to the previous method on its own instead of breaking the panel.
Battle overlays: gun traverse limits, the autoaim indicator and target information send only changed values to Flash.
Compatibility: Python 2.7 and World of Tanks 2.4.1.1 on EU, NA and ASIA. Signed beta release; tested on the EU client in random and Frontline replays.
